name: Sanjeevani Heart & Multispeciality Institute
description: A 650-bed tertiary-care institute known for cardiac sciences, joint replacement and living-donor transplants. The international patient lounge offers in-house interpreters, visa invitation letters, airport pickup and a dedicated case manager for every patient.
address: Plot 7, Sector 44, Golf Course Road, Gurugram

reviews.title: Walking without pain again
reviews.body: From the first video consultation to discharge everything was explained clearly. I was walking the corridor the day after surgery and the physiotherapists were excellent.
